The main takeaway from our work is that
although EEG based sleep trackers have the potential to provide more accurate sleep measurements, the current generation of consumer sleep trackers do not perform better than fitness wristbands.
the accuracy of home sleep trackers is not necessarily better with more sophisticated technology and that there is no clear advantage of one type of home sleep trackers over the other.
the measurements of sleep by consumer sleep trackers should be interpreted with caution.
